summary: Black Spade Acquisition III Co, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K on August 27, 2026, disclosing entry into a Business Combination Agreement with Astrum Space Inc and its subsidiary Astrum Networks Pte. Ltd. Under the agreement, Astrum will merge with and into Black Spade III, which will survive, and Astrum Singapore will become a wholly-owned subsidiary. The filing describes pre-closing mechanics: units will separate into Class A shares and warrants, and Class B ordinary shares will convert to Class A shares. This is an initial SPAC merger announcement; terms such as valuation, premium, and consideration are not stated in the excerpt. Watch for redemptions and shareholder vote details.
